name: Tenohira o, Taiyou ni
original_name: てのひらを、たいように
source: Haruno Akio lives his days without interest in anything, going to school for a vague reason he himself does not remember. One day a transfer student comes to his class, claiming she knows him and bringing with her the much needed wind of change that revitalizes his stale life and lets him rebuild his relationships with his estranged childhood friends.
translation: 春野明生對任何事都提不起興趣，甚至不記得自己究竟為何還在上學。某天，一名轉學生轉進他班上，聲稱認識他。她為明生停滯的生活帶來了迫切需要的改變，也使他得以與早已疏遠的兒時玩伴重修舊好。
